name: Evidence-Controlled Research Brief
problem: A decision-maker needs a sourced research answer with provenance, contradiction handling, uncertainty and a bounded deliverable instead of a generic web summary.
use_when: make me a decision grade research report
map the evidence for this issue
give me a sourced validation memo
inputs: Research question and requester identity; optional organization, sector, geography, decision context, urgency, evidence standard and deliverable type.
outputs: Decision brief/report/evidence map/dataset/validation memo with findings, uncertainties, recommendations, evidence count, confidence and underlying evidence records.
pricing: No approved fixed machine price verified. Raven contains research-service hypotheses, but they remain hypotheses and are not auto-quotable.
confirmation: Research may be scoped without obligation. Paid work and consequential-domain deliverables require explicit confirmation and existing review gates.
payment_authority: No verified Evercraft Payments path for this capability.
invocation_status: MIGRATION HOLD: legacy Base44 route removed. Use Evercraft Fabric for discovery; direct execution, checkout and fulfillment require independent owned-runtime verification.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
